description: This file implements atomic operations in C for processors lacking native support, including compare-and-swap, add, subtract, get, set, and bitwise operations, with support for user space system calls and SMP considerations.

methods.name: z_impl_atomic_cas
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap operation on an atomic variable.

methods.name: z_vrfy_atomic_cas
methods.description: Verifies and performs atomic compare-and-swap in user space context.

methods.name: z_impl_atomic_ptr_cas
methods.description: Performs an atomic compare-and-swap on atomic pointer variables.

methods.name: z_vrfy_atomic_ptr_cas
methods.description: Verifies and performs atomic pointer compare-and-swap in user space context.

methods.name: atomic_get
methods.description: Atomically reads the value of an atomic variable.

methods.name: atomic_ptr_get
methods.description: Atomically reads the value of an atomic pointer.

methods.name: z_impl_atomic_set
methods.description: Atomically sets the value of an atomic variable.

methods.name: atomic_ptr_set
methods.description: Atomically sets the value of an atomic pointer.

methods.name: z_vrfy_atomic_ptr_set
methods.description: Verifies and performs atomic pointer set in user space context.

methods.name: atomic_or
methods.description: Atomically performs bitwise OR on an atomic variable.

methods.name: atomic_xor
methods.description: Atomically performs bitwise XOR on an atomic variable.

methods.name: atomic_and
methods.description: Atomically performs bitwise AND on an atomic variable.

methods.name: atomic_nand
methods.description: Atomically performs bitwise NAND on an atomic variable.

methods.name: z_impl_atomic_add
methods.description: Performs an atomic addition on an atomic variable.

methods.name: z_impl_atomic_sub
methods.description: Performs an atomic subtraction on an atomic variable.
